summary: This research study is testing a new medicine called NNC0662-3168 for weight management and type 2 diabetes, a condition where the body has trouble handling sugar. The study will test how safe the medicine is and how the body handles it. Participants will include adults who are overweight or have obesity, as well as those with type 2 diabetes. The trial is sponsored by Novo Nordisk A/S and aims to enroll 300 participants.
